purpose: Test on fresh untouched graph instances whether a cheap structural gate can avoid paying for a seeded-diverse restart when the diverse start is structurally implausible. The gate threshold was selected after observing the development matrix and the separate small-holdout V1, so only this new holdout can supply transfer evidence for the gate.
formula: Positive monotone graph 2-CNF: conjunction over edges (x_u OR x_v).
compiler: Same exact Shannon/reduced ordered BDD compiler and exhaustive truth-bitset plus Hamming-rank oracle as small-holdout V1.

local_search.selection: minimum live nodes then allocated nodes then lexicographic order

seeded_diverse.selection: same deterministic max-min normalized Kendall rule as small-holdout V1 with eligibility <= min(conventional widths)+2 and minimum-width fallback

gate.name: seed_width_plus1
gate.decision: include seeded arm iff seeded start vertex-separation width <= min(natural width, RCM width)+1; otherwise run the two-arm controller
gate.rationale: The prior development seeded win had post-stage width one above RCM while the fresh small holdout seeded starts were at least two above the best conventional width or fallback-poor. This rule is outcome-derived and therefore has no evidential status until tested here.
gate.cost_accounting: Always charge generation of the 24 seeded candidate permutations and their width/Kendall screening to structural_screen_ms and width_evaluations even when seeded is skipped. BDD candidate compilations remain the primary expensive cost.

policies.two_arm_one_then_commit: natural+RCM one-stage screening then commit winner and continue to <=3 accepted moves
policies.always_three_arm_one_then_commit: natural+RCM+seeded one-stage screening then commit winner and continue to <=3 accepted moves
policies.gated_three_arm: apply seed_width_plus1 before any seeded BDD compilation; if gate false run two-arm; if true run three-arm
policies.full_two_arm3: run natural and RCM independently to <=3 accepted moves and select best endpoint

predeclared_tests: All completed endpoints must match exact truth bitset and rank vector.
Primary: compare gated_three_arm with always_three_arm on final live nodes and charged BDD candidate compilations; report gate-open frequency.

Secondary: compare gated_three_arm with two_arm and full_two_arm3. A gate is useful only if it avoids seeded BDD work without increasing final live nodes on the tested cell, or if opening it yields a quality improvement worth explicit cost.
Report every false-negative gate event where seeded would have won after one stage or produced a better final endpoint under always-three but the gate skipped it.
Report every false-positive gate event where gate opened but seeded neither won the commit nor improved final endpoint.
Do not tune threshold after outcomes; any revised threshold requires a new untouched holdout.

resource_guard.on_guard: mark incomplete and exclude from gate-quality claims

scope: Synthetic small positive-monotone 2-CNF BDD ordering only. Structural gate is a cheap action-selection heuristic, not a universal BDD ordering theorem or proof-utility policy.
